SPIREENIGMAS-CHERISHED.title: Cherished
SPIREENIGMAS-CHERISHED.description: #If this card would be *Exhausted*, it loses *Cherished* instead.
SPIREENIGMAS-DIRE.title: Dire
SPIREENIGMAS-DIRE.description: #This card be played for HP if you don't have enough Energy. If you do, it *Exhausts*.
SPIREENIGMAS-IMPROVISE.title: Improvise
SPIREENIGMAS-IMPROVISE.description: #This card is free to play the first time it is drawn during each of your turns.
SPIREENIGMAS-TIMELOOP.title: Time Loop
SPIREENIGMAS-TIMELOOP.description: #Whenever you play another card, this *Transforms* into a copy of it.
SPIREENIGMAS-COMMAND.title: Command
SPIREENIGMAS-COMMAND.description: #This card is performed by *Chirp*, and only *Chirp's* [E] may be spent on it.
